# Draft:Sure Kicks Sneaker Kings Basketball

Sure Kicks Sneaker Kings, a basketball team in Butuan City with the most number of Championships in Agusan del Norte. A total of 30 championships that can be shown on the details below. This team started its program in 2022, winning back to back Intercity Championships in Gingoog City, then later on, won another title in Butuan City.
List of Championships:
21 Under - 8x
22 under - 2x
23 under - 3x
24 under - 1x
25 under - 8x
Open Commercial Division - 8x
This is the only team who accomplished back to back 5-peats in Interbarangay & Mixed categories in a year. Their goal is to promote local talents available in Butuan City.
